findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess with shell=True
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True and user-controlled input can lead to command injection
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-shell
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getMember("get").getACall() and
      source = call
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
      ) and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user-controlled input"
findings.hypothesis: Command injection via subprocess calls with shell=True using untrusted input from environment variables or remote sources

message.text:
Potential command injection from [user-controlled input](1).
Potential command injection from [user-controlled input](2).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe archive extraction
 * @description Extracting archives without path validation may allow path traversal
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-archive-extraction
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["open", "TarFile"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe archive extraction that may allow path traversal attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Archive extraction operations without path validation can allow attackers to write files outside the intended directory via path traversal sequences like '../'

message.text: Potentially unsafe archive extraction that may allow path traversal attacks.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description File operations with unsanitized user input may allow accessing files outside intended directory
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal-file-ops
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "removedirs", "mkdir", "makedirs", "rename"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree", "move", "copy", "copy2", "copytree"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  ) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
    arg = call.getArg(0) and
    // Look for string concatenation or join operations that might enable path traversal
    (
      arg.asExpr() instanceof BinaryExpr or
      exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode joinCall |
        joinCall.getFunction().(DataFlow::AttrRead).getAttributeName() = "join" and
        arg = joinCall
      )
    )
  )
select call, "File operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal."
findings.hypothesis: File operations using path concatenation without validation could allow path traversal attacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization with pickle
 * @description Using pickle to deserialize untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-pickle-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Detecting unsafe deserialization with pickle, marshal, or shelve that can lead to arbitrary code execution
